name: NEXTDC S6 Sydney

address.note: the address comes from third-party listings (datacentermap, datacenterHawk); NEXTDC's ASX release did not name the address

lat.note: not geocoded: the geocoder (nominatim) was blocked by the network proxy in this session

developer.note: the core and shell was built by a third party (vendor not disclosed) and bought by NEXTDC in March 2024; NEXTDC did the fit-out. inflect.com associates 3 Broadcast Way with Keppel Data Centres 'Sydney 1' (unverified)

mw_it.note: up to 13.5 MW across 4,000 sqm of data hall; master.csv notes 2.7 MW built and 10.8 MW in progress

cost_aud_m.note: acquisition price A$184m (land plus completed core and shell, ASX release 12 Mar 2024), which is not a construction cost. SNPP report for DA 2018/273/A at 3 Broadcast Way gives a CIV of $37,176,000 (source 3); unverified whether this is the S6 building

authority.note: Willoughby Council DA determined by the regional planning panel (PPSSNH-23)

pathway.value: Regionally significant DA (council DA determined by planning panel)

reference.note: inferred from the address match only (SNPP report on modification DA 2018/273/A, Feb 2020). Not confirmed that this DA covers the S6 data centre building

construction_end.note: core and shell completed 1H CY2022 (ASX release). NEXTDC fit-out and opening followed in 2024 (Wikipedia), which explains the 2022-vs-2024 conflict in master.csv

open_questions: original developer/vendor and core-and-shell builder unknown
confirm DA 2018/273 (3 Broadcast Way) is the S6 building; its determination date and CIV
operational date: shell completed 1H 2022, NEXTDC opened 2024; fit-out builder unknown
